title: Team Member - Data Privacy
description:
Role summary\- You will support the execution of the organization’s Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program by conducting privacy due diligence assessments of vendors, identifying data privacy risks, ensuring compliance with applicable privacy laws and internal policies, and maintaining assessment documentation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \-
   

  

* Conduct privacy risk assessments for third\-party vendors during onboarding and periodic reviews.
* Review vendor responses to privacy questionnaires and supporting evidences.
* Assess vendors processing personal data against applicable privacy regulations (e.g., India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, General Data Protection Regulation where applicable).
* Identify privacy risks, document observations, and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Track remediation actions and follow up with internal stakeholders and vendors until closure.
* Maintain records of completed assessments, risk ratings, and supporting evidence.
* Assist in developing and updating privacy assessment questionnaires, templates, and SOPs.
* Support in audits and regulatory inspections by providing required privacy assessment documentation.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports and dashboards on TPRM assessment status and key metrics.


 Required skill \-
   

  

* Basic understanding of data privacy principles and regulations.
* Knowledge of vendor risk assessment or Third\-Party Risk Management concepts.
* Good analytical and documentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.


 Experience: 3\-4 year (Freshers with relevant certifications and data privacy internship experience may also apply)
   

  

 Education: Bachelor’s degree in law, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field.

title: Associate Contract Manager, Amazon MGM Studios
description:
**Description**
 Amazon MGM Studios Legal (India) is hiring an Associate Contracts Manager to support its growing slate of original content across film and series production, content licensing, and talent engagements in India. In this position, you will:
   

  

* Support the negotiation, drafting, and management of entertainment and production\-related agreements across India
* Ensure contracts are commercially sound, compliant with local regulations, and aligned with studio business objectives
* Serve as a point of contact for cross\-functional teams — including production, business affairs, marketing, and finance—on contractual matters
* Leverage technology and automation tools to enhance contract management efficiency and scalability
* Assist in developing standardized templates, playbooks, and self\-service resources tailored to studios operations in India
* Contribute to the team's goal of delivering operational excellence while supporting a fast\-moving, creative business


 You'll be part of a nimble, high\-impact legal team that partners closely with creative and business stakeholders to bring stories to audiences across India and globally.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Draft, review, and negotiate a variety of entertainment agreements including production services agreements, talent agreements, content licensing deals, music licenses, post\-production and VFX contracts, marketing and publicity agreements, and vendor/service agreements
   

  

 Manage contract lifecycle from initiation through execution, ensuring timely turnaround on high\-volume deal flow
   

  

 Provide guidance to business teams on contract terms, risks, and standard practices specific to the Indian entertainment industry
   

  

 Create and maintain standardized contract templates and playbooks for recurring deal types, leveraging AI and other technology tools
   

  

 Oversee and maintain a contracts database; develop mechanisms to track transactions and surface insights at scale
   

  

 Coordinate with outside counsel on specialized matters and ensure alignment with internal legal positions
   

  

 Ensure compliance with Indian regulatory requirements, including those related to intellectual property, labour/employment, censorship/content regulation, and tax/withholding obligations
   

  

 Identify opportunities for process improvement, workflow automation, and self\-service enablement for business clients
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Review and respond to incoming contract requests from creative, business affairs, production, marketing and PR teams
   

  

 Draft and negotiate production services agreements, amendments, and statements of work
   

  

 Host consultation sessions with business stakeholders to provide guidance on deal structures and contract terms
   

  

 Build and maintain digital playbooks and FAQs for common entertainment contract scenarios in India
   

  

 Support the development of business self\-help tools and decision trees for routine contract matters
   

  

 Assist in creating automated workflow solutions for standard, repeatable contract requests
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional legal colleagues in other countries on multi\-territory deals and templates
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon MGM Studios Legal (India) is a team of legal professionals that advises, collaborates with, and guides creative and business clients in delivering compelling content to audiences in India and around the world.
   

  

 We operate at the intersection of entertainment, technology, and law \- supporting original film and series production, content acquisition, talent relationships, and marketing in a dynamic and culturally rich market.
   

  

 We are committed to operational excellence, innovation, and inclusion. We leverage technology and automation to scale our impact, empower our business clients with tools and resources, and focus our energy on high\-value, complex legal work.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience in contracts management, leading or supporting contract negotiations, and drafting contracts, or other comparable roles
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, SharePoint, and PowerPoint)
* 2\+ years of drafting and negotiating the legal terms in a broad range of standard commercial contracts experience
* BA/BS or LLB degree (or equivalent)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Can use AI for legal research, contract analysis, or document review experience
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Experience in the entertainment, media, or content production industry
* Familiarity with Indian entertainment industry practices, including talent engagements, production workflows, and content licensing
* Previous in\-house legal experience, ideally at a studio, production company, or media/tech company
* Background in process improvement, workflow optimization, or digital transformation
* High attention to detail with proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously
* Self\-starter mindset with a focus on excellence, adaptability, and continuous learning
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across time zones and cultures

description:
**Main purpose** 








 The incumbent will be responsible for assessing the overall trade flow plan including commercial terms, cargo operations, payment terms and legal obligations of sale and purchase transactions concluded by the company. The incumbent will then draft or review the underlying commercial contracts keeping in mind Trafigura’s interests and business strategy and will also highlight all potential risks for consultation with other key departments such as Trading, Cargo Operations, Trade Finance, Claims, Legal etc.
 







**Key responsibilities** 







* Assessing commercial, operational and legal risks in a sale/purchase transaction and highlight the same promptly to relevant departments
* Preparing and reviewing contracts for the physical movement of oil via vessel/trucks/rail car/pipeline which accurately reflect the verbal negotiations
* Processing and reviewing of contractual amendments, including the countering of commercial terms, operational terms, payment provisions, lay time and demurrage provisions, and legal provisions
* Liaising with traders, operators and other internal departments highlighting potential risks in the transactions and providing advice to reduce the same
* Preparing and reviewing other oil related agreements including; tender documents, book out agreements, storage agreements, master trading agreements, and counterparty general terms and conditions
* Liaise closely with other departments to discuss and finalize company’s contractual position
* Issue final contracts, termination agreement, Non\-Disclosure Agreements or amendments after compiling views of key departments
* Pro\-actively liaise with stakeholders to achieve mutually acceptable contractual position
* Take advisory role to suggest traders’ ways to mitigate key risks and highlight those exceptions to management
* Timely filing of contracts, amendments, communications on the in\-house database management software’s
* Strict adherence and compliance to Trafigura’s policy and codes







**Required qualifications** 







* Minimum  1 years experience in drafting \& reviewing of contracts


* Commerce, Business Administration, Law or equivalent qualification with impressive academic credentials
* Basic knowledge of international commercial terms (Incoterms 2000, 2010 and 2020

* Strong communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Accurate and efficient working style with high attention to detail
* Computer literacy: MS Word, MS Excel and Outlook
* Adaptive to change
* Self\-starter and pro\-active attitude
* Fluent in English. Knowledge of French language is advantageous
* Willingness to work in flexible time zones







**Department overview** 




 The Contract Administration Department acts as a key control function to safeguard the company’s commercial and legal interests in sale and purchase of commodities. The department is responsible to review trades concluded by the company, highlight any potential risk that may arise during the transaction and take appropriate measures to mitigate them while drafting/reviewing the underlying contracts in consultation with other departments.
 







**Key Relationships** 



* Counterparties
* Traders
* Cargo Operators
* Trade Finance
* Deals Desk
* Claims

description:
**Head of Anti\-Piracy \& Platform Partnerships**
**About the Role:**
 JioStar is India's leading media and entertainment business, home to JioHotstar (500M\+ monthly active users) and the exclusive home of the IPL (₹47,551 Cr rights value), ICC events and India's most\-watched entertainment. With piracy costing India's video sector an estimated $1\.2 billion annually, content protection is a key priority.
   

  

 This is a build\-and\-lead mandate. The function operates as a lean, intelligence\-led command centre. The Head of Anti\-Piracy \& Platform Partnerships will own operational strategy, platform governance, vendor management, law enforcement coordination and live\-event readiness across domestic and future international markets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategy \& Operations:**
* Own end\-to\-end execution of JioStar's anti\-piracy strategy across broadcast, OTT, IPTV, social media and emerging ecosystems.
* Define the function's operating model, KPIs and business\-impact metrics — moving beyond volume\-based takedown counts.
* Lead international expansion planning: jurisdictional scoping, coalition partnerships, and phased capability build\-out.


**Platform Partnerships \& Escalation:**
* Own senior relationships with Meta, Google/YouTube, Telegram, ISPs, hosting providers, registrars and CDNs.
* Lead escalation pathways for high\-priority takedowns, repeat\-offender action and live\-event enforcement.
* Represent JioStar in industry coalitions and platform trust \& safety forums (ACE, IBCAP, AAPA and equivalents).


**Live\-Event Anti\-Piracy Operations:**
* Command the live\-event anti\-piracy operation for IPL, ICC and premium events — 24/7 control\-room oversight, mobilization within hours.
* Establish playbooks for restream takedowns, app\-store enforcement and ISP\-level blocking during marquee fixtures.


**Intelligence, Investigations \& Vendor Governance:**
* Oversee the Intelligence \& Investigations and the Data, Automation \& Vendor Governance portfolio; ensure intelligence precedes every enforcement action.
* Govern the external vendor ecosystem: set SLAs, manage performance, rationalize the partner footprint and drive automation.


**Law Enforcement, Legal \& Regional Coordination:**
* Build senior relationships with national and state law enforcement, cyber cells, and MIB.
* Direct Regional Enforcement Coordinators on field operations, raids and state\-level piracy disruption.
* Partner with in\-house Legal on orders, dynamic injunctions, site\-blocking and criminal complaints.


**Executive Engagement:**
* Drive cross\-functional coordination with Business, Legal, Distribution, Content Operations and Technology.
* Deliver executive reporting on threat landscape, enforcement outcomes and business impact to senior leadership.


**Required Experience \& Capabilities:**
* 15\+ years in OTT, digital media, broadcasting or Trust \& Safety, with a meaningful share in content protection, anti\-piracy, fraud or platform integrity.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-stakeholder enforcement programs at scale across digital, broadcast and physical distribution.
* Direct engagement with Meta, Google/YouTube, Telegram, ISPs and hosting providers at a senior governance level.
* Deep, current understanding of digital piracy ecosystems — illegal IPTV networks, restream chains, Telegram piracy, cyberlockers and app\-based modalities.
* Intelligence orientation — approaches problems as an investigator, not an operator; comfortable with attribution analysis and OSINT outputs.
* Systems thinking, platform ecosystem fluency, operational maturity and strong stakeholder management at executive, regulatory and law\-enforcement levels.
* Live\-event content protection operations experience strongly preferred.


**Alternative Backgrounds Considered:**
*JioStar will actively consider Ex\-Armed Forces SSC officers (Indian Navy / Air Force) from Signals, Intelligence, Cyber or Information Warfare backgrounds with demonstrable platform\-ecosystem fluency.*

 About the Role
   

  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Assistant Manager \- Procurement Audit** 
 to strengthen procurement governance, ensure compliance with company policies, and identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization. The incumbent will be responsible for auditing procurement activities, assessing risks, evaluating controls, and working closely with Procurement, Finance, Projects, and Business stakeholders.

 Audit Reporting \& Analytics

* Track and monitor closure of audit findings with relevant stakeholders.

 Stakeholder Management

* Conduct discussions with stakeholders to understand processes and validate observations.
* Drive awareness and implementation of procurement best practices across the organization.

 Education
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, or Procurement preferred.



 Experience
   

  




* 5\-8 years of experience in Procurement Audit, Internal Audit, Procurement Operations, Supply Chain Controls, or Risk Management.
* Experience in Construction, Real Estate, Infrastructure, EPC, Manufacturing, Engineering Services, or Project\-based organizations is preferred.
* Exposure to procurement lifecycle audits and vendor compliance reviews.


**Additional Information**

description:
**Job Title \- Associate Director, Litigation**
**Department, Level** 
 \- Corporate Legal
   

  

**Location**

**Role Overview**
* Jiostar is looking for a bright, highly motivated individual to serve as Associate Director\-Legal (Dispute Resolution) for its India business. This individual will work with the Jiostar Corporate Legal team in India.
* Candidate will be responsible in handling pre\-litigation advisory, and litigation matters by and against the company involving both civil and criminal laws. The Candidate will be responsible for a broad range of legal matters related to copyright, trademark, IPR protection, commercial and contractual disputes, and other issues involving civil \& criminal, employment laws.
* Candidate should also have good knowledge about conducting preliminary knock\-out searches, content due\-diligence, risk analysis of scripts, screenplays, movies, musical content and web\-series, and anti\-piracy actions.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Drafting and reviewing of pleadings, notices, replies, and other documents in relation to ongoing legal disputes and litigations pertaining to copyright disputes, trademark disputes, infringement of personality and privacy rights, breach of contractual obligations and other commercial and civil disputes;
* Management of company litigations through formulation and execution of effective litigation strategy, including briefing and appointment of attorneys and Senior Counsels.
* Advising and providing legal opinions to various business units on complex legal issues and recent legal developments to ensure risk mitigation.
* Working knowledge of operations and management of legal aspects of copyright and media laws.
* Managing and advising on contentious litigation and regulatory affairs and liaising with statutory authorities.
* Conducting pre\-release due diligence and risk analysis of scripts, screenplays, movies, musical content and web\-series to ensure smooth release and for avoidance of legal disputes.


**Key Skills**
* Candidate should have good knowledge of copyrights laws, civil\-commercial laws, criminal laws and familiarity with court proceedings and should be capable of handling matters.
* Good contract/corporate knowledge.
* Strong command of the English language.
* Ability to manage time judiciously and deal effectively with the competing interests of several different individuals/departments.
* Proven track record of ability to manage a team.
* Business oriented commercial mindset with a flexible, practical problem\-solving approach.
* Should excel in a fast\-paced commercial environment and be able to function largely autonomously with minimal supervision taking into account departmental and business imperatives.
* Mature, level\-headed and calm disposition.
* Confident and sociable.
* High competency in general programs like Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and email applications for business.


**Preferred Education \& Experience**
* 7\-9 years Post Qualification experience with majority experience preferably in a media\-entertainment company or an IP Litigation law firm.


**About Us (Boilerplate)**
 Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media \& entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and steaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of millions of people across geographies.

title: Assistant Manager- Legal, Mumbai
description:
Location:
   

  

 Mumbai, MH, IN
   

  

 Areas of Work: Corporate Finance Job Id: 15503
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Seeking a proactive legal professional with 4\-7 years' experience in Legal Metrology and Contracts, preferably in FMCG/Manufacturing/Retail. The candidate must have hands\-on experience in Legal Metrology laws and Packaged Commodities Regulations. Responsibilities include ensuring label compliance, artwork and label approvals, stakeholder communication, legal training, and compliance audits under the Legal Metrology Act and allied rules. Candidate should have knowledge on drafting and negotiating contracts.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Safeguard the Company's interests by providing legal support on commercial and business transactions, drafting and negotiating contracts, minimizing legal and commercial risks, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting dispute management. The role will primarily focus on contract management while demonstrating willingness to support Legal Metrology compliance initiatives as required.
   

  

**BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITY AREAS**
* Contract Drafting \& Negotiation
* Draft, review, negotiate and finalize a wide range of commercial contracts, including procurement agreements, service agreements, NDAs, marketing agreements, logistics contracts, consultancy agreements, amendments and other business\-related documents.
* Identify legal, commercial and operational risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Standardize contract templates and assist in developing contracting playbooks.
* Provide legal support during negotiations with customers, vendors, service providers and other stakeholders.
* Legal Advisory \& Risk Management
* Advise business teams on contractual rights, obligations, liabilities, indemnities, warranties, limitation of liability and dispute resolution mechanisms.
* Ensure business transactions comply with applicable laws, company policies and internal approval frameworks.
* Conduct legal due diligence and support evaluation of strategic business projects.
* Contract Governance \& Compliance
* Monitor contract lifecycle management, including execution, amendments, renewals and closures.
* Maintain contract repositories and ensure proper record keeping and document management.
* Support periodic audits and compliance reviews relating to contractual obligations.
* Dispute \& Litigation Support
* Assist in managing contractual disputes, claims, legal notices and commercial disagreements arising from business transactions.
* Support assessment of legal risks, contractual exposure and dispute resolution strategies to safeguard the Company's interests.
* Coordinate with external counsel, business teams and internal stakeholders for litigation, arbitration, mediation and other dispute resolution proceedings.
* Assist in the preparation, review and management of legal notices, replies, pleadings, legal opinions, claim assessments and settlement documentation.
* Monitor ongoing litigation and dispute matters, maintain case records and ensure timely submission of required documents and information.
* Support preservation of evidence, fact\-finding exercises and internal investigations relating to contractual and commercial disputes.
* Work closely with business teams to identify contentious issues at an early stage and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Assist in enforcing contractual rights, remedies and dispute resolution mechanisms under various commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in negotiating and documenting settlements, compromise arrangements and dispute closure mechanisms.
* Derive learnings from disputes and claims to strengthen contracting practices, risk allocation provisions and contract governance frameworks.
* Assist in managing contentious matters, high\-stake disputes, strategic litigation and business\-critical legal issues having significant financial, operational, regulatory or reputational impact on the Company.
* Support preparation of management updates, litigation trackers and risk reports for senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Management \& Training
* Partner with Sales, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing and other business functions to provide timely legal support.
* Conduct training sessions and awareness programs on contracts, legal risks and governance requirements.
* Regulatory Support
* Track legal and regulatory developments impacting commercial contracts and business operations.
* Support implementation of legal compliance initiatives across the organization.
* Legal Metrology (Developmental Exposure)
* Demonstrate an interest and willingness to learn and support Legal Metrology compliance matters, including product labelling and packaging requirements under the Legal Metrology framework.

title: Senior Vice President, Compliance & Control
description:
**Job Description**
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**
 The role within the Risk and Compliance Assurance Testing (RCAT) function is responsible for leading an independent technology control testing activities across technology processes, systems, and control environments. The role supports the design, execution, and continuous enhancement of the RCAT testing framework to ensure testing is risk\-based, and conducted in accordance with established policies, standards, and methodologies.
   

  

* Lead and execute independent testing of technology controls, including control design assessment, operating effectiveness testing, evidence review, and documentation of results.
* Support the maintenance and enhancement of testing methodologies, procedures, and standards, and recommend improvements to testing processes, controls, and governance practices as needed.
* Evaluate technology risks and control environments across key domains, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity and access management, change management, data management, application controls, and resilience.
* Identify control deficiencies, thematic issues, and areas of heightened risk, and provide effective challenge on remediation plans, root causes, and control improvements.
* Ensure testing workpapers, supporting documentation, and reporting outputs meet quality standards, framework requirements, and established timelines.
* Support governance and reporting processes by contributing to internal RCAT meetings, stakeholder forums, and committees, including preparation of testing results, issue themes, and management information.
* Partner with technology, business, risk, compliance, and audit stakeholders to promote transparency, coordination, and consistency in control testing and issue management activities.
* Provide guidance and support to team members on testing methodology, documentation standards, and technology risk and control expectations.
* Engage with Internal Audit and other independent risk and control functions to help streamline coverage, coordinate activities where appropriate, and communicate the status of issues, validation results, and control outcomes.


**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Significant experience in technology risk, technology controls, and/or assurance testing roles.
* Strong knowledge of technology control frameworks, regulatory expectations, and risk management practices applicable to financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, provide credible challenge, and communicate complex control and risk matters clearly and effectively.
* Proven record of leadership and execution in control testing, technology risk, audit, or related assurance disciplines.
* Typically, 10\+ years of relevant experience in technology risk, control testing, audit, cybersecurity risk, or related assurance functions.
* Proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Java, JavaScript, C\#, C\+\+, Python, and SQL
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to provide credible challenge and partner effectively across technology, risk, compliance, audit, and business teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess control effectiveness and synthesize findings into clear, actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise reporting for senior management and governance forums.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and maintain high standards of quality and consistency in a fast\-paced environment.
